arguments.text: 8000 m, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Pacer sets effort; I watch for (1) weed/drag: GPS speed falls at the same pod power (drag_gap drops, both directions) -> test with clear_rudder, check dip+recovery; (2) pod drift: pod power moves but heart rate and GPS speed do not follow -> set pod_gain; (3) radio course changes -> set_race_distance + tell paddler; (4) critical power off: heart rate keeps climbing below pod CP (CP too high) or flat well above CP (CP too low). Compare legs in same direction to separate current from drag. Keep cues few.

arguments.text: 8000 m, 8 legs of 1000 m (odd legs out/north, even legs back; leg 8 back to finish). Pacer sets effort. Known so far: pod CP ~198 (HR test), boat CP set 148, share of pod power to boat ~0.73-0.75. Current/wind SHIFTED ~900 s: out push from +0.10 to about -0.04 (now helps back legs); computer push_along lags, so boat-speed numbers (boat reserve, fade, pace gap) are unreliable for a few legs - trust pod reserve. Watch for: weed/drag (slow in BOTH directions at same pod power -> clear_rudder), pod drift (pod vs HR and GPS disagree -> pod_gain), radio course change (set_race_distance + tell). Keep cues few.
